pm_mode_enabled.meaning: Governor has enabled PM mode on the vault
pm_mode_enabled.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

hedge_asset_whitelisted.meaning: Governor has whitelisted the hedge asset used by executeHedge()
hedge_asset_whitelisted.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

supplied_slot_active.meaning: the 0x811 supplied slot is actually active on HyperCore at the time the accountant reads it
supplied_slot_active.checkpoint: at the strict backing read performed during settlement

settlement_flows_frozen.meaning: critical accounting and settlement flows are frozen (settlement cannot evaluate distributable surplus because the total backing read reverts)
settlement_flows_frozen.checkpoint: after the strict backing read reverts during settlement

assumptions: The operator is not treated as malicious; the failure is described as internal self-poisoning rather than an unauthorized call.
The spot leg being enqueued, delayed, or partially/unfilled is the report's stated scenario under which the supplied slot is not yet active.
The strict backing read (totalBackingSigned()) is the settlement step whose revert halts settlement.

unresolved.description: Report does not tie the totalBackingSigned() read to a specific transaction/checkpoint, so the settlement read checkpoint is only qualitatively located.
Whether the supplied slot is inactive at read time is conditional ('may not exist yet'); the scenario is potential, not observed.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario, not an inevitable freeze.
No numeric bounds or amounts are given for the supplied slot or backing values; the relation is qualitative.
Only the selected impact freeze_critical_accounting_settlement_flows is formalized; other impacts are out of scope for this pass.
